subject: 54 South Street Certificate of Compliance
overview: The Commission approved a Certificate of Compliance for a residential project on South Street and discussed upcoming invasive species management and city-wide permit audits.

items.title: 54 South Street Certificate of Compliance (DEP #2150230)
items.summary: Approved a Certificate of Compliance for a residential addition within the riverfront area following a review of as-built plans and site plantings. The Commission confirmed that the implemented landscape plan met the original order of conditions.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Tabled the approval of the previous meeting's minutes to the next session to allow for additional review.

items.title: Staff Reports and Project Updates
items.summary: Staff announced a upcoming permit file audit by a new intern, a pending filing for invasive species cleanup at McDonald Park, and the annual municipal rain barrel sale. The Commission also discussed a reported accumulation of debris near the state police barracks slated for removal.
